origin: External modelcontextprotocol maintainers; PyPI PEP 740 publisher attestations are signed by upstream GitHub Actions release workflow, not RISU.

issue.kind: repository-local core.fsmonitor configured program can run during nominally read-only MCP git_status

publisher.artifact_type: PyPI signed wheel with PEP 740 Publish Attestation
publisher.publishing_identity_source: independently verify via pypi-attestations verify pypi --repository https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers <wheel_url>
publisher.provenance_claim_limit: PEP 740 publish attestation signs publication of the wheel, not necessarily a complete hermetic SLSA build. Exact artifact SHA and extracted code match pinned upstream source separately.

cases.repository_config: core.fsmonitor points to benign local marker script

runtime.safety: Isolated GitHub-hosted runner, only synthetic tmp Git repos, benign script writes a fixed marker under the same temp root, sanitized subprocess env, no credentials, no network interactions via tool, no user data, never execute untrusted arbitrary shell commands.

registered_measure.independent_witness: marker file existence plus SHA, before/after measurement, process PID, Python executable SHA, installed module code SHA and signed wheel SHA
registered_measure.failure_rule: Only observed original marker difference with both original expected tool statuses and both publisher wheel attestations cryptographically verified may be called REPRODUCED_KNOWN_UPSTREAM_REPAIR.
registered_measure.model: two versions x configured normal; no new upstream defect claim; no population precision/recall.

controls: wrong source revision / code blob fails
same expected marker in both versions yields no repair
tool error cannot be counted as repaired safe behavior
tampered JSON-RPC or marker hashes fail
